title: BayFirst Financial Corp. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla., Aug. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BayFirst Financial Corp. (NASDAQ: BAFN) (“BayFirst” or “Company”), parent company of BayFirst National Bank (“Bank”) reported a net loss of $32.7 million, or $8.05 per common share and diluted common share, for the second quarter of 2026, compared to a restated net loss of $5.9 million, or $1.54 per common share and diluted common share, in the first quarter of 2026.
